-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- LAYER 01: STRING.BYTE INTEGRITY
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function _L01()
    if _s_byte("A",1)~=65 then return false end
    if _s_byte("a",1)~=97 then return false end
    if _s_byte("0",1)~=48 then return false end
    if _s_byte("z",1)~=122 then return false end
    if _s_byte("!",1)~=33 then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 02: STRING.CHAR INTEGRITY
local function _L02()
    if _s_char(65)~="A" then return false end
    if _s_char(97)~="a" then return false end
    if _s_char(48)~="0" then return false end
    if _s_char(122)~="z" then return false end
    if _s_char(33)~="!" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 03: STRING.SUB INTEGRITY
local function _L03()
    if _s_sub("hello",1,2)~="he" then return false end
    if _s_sub("hello",2,3)~="el" then return false end
    if _s_sub("hello",-2)~="lo" then return false end
    if _s_sub("hello",3)~="llo" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 04: STRING.FORMAT INTEGRITY
local function _L04()
    if _s_format("%d",42)~="42" then return false end
    if _s_format("%s","x")~="x" then return false end
    if _s_format("%02x",15)~="0f" then return false end
    if _s_format("%04x",255)~="00ff" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 05: STRING.REP INTEGRITY
local function _L05()
    if _s_rep("a",3)~="aaa" then return false end
    if _s_rep("ab",2)~="abab" then return false end
    if _s_rep("x",5)~="xxxxx" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 06: STRING.LOWER/UPPER
local function _L06()
    if _s_lower("ABC")~="abc" then return false end
    if _s_upper("abc")~="ABC" then return false end
    if _s_lower("Hello")~="hello" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 07: TABLE.CONCAT
local function _L07()
    if _t_concat({"a","b","c"})~="abc" then return false end
    if _t_concat({1,2,3},"-")~="1-2-3" then return false end
    if _t_concat({"x"})~="x" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 08: TABLE.INSERT/REMOVE
local function _L08()
    local t={}
    _t_insert(t,"a")
    _t_insert(t,"b")
    if t[1]~="a" or t[2]~="b" then return false end
    _t_remove(t)
    if #t~=1 then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 09: TONUMBER
local function _L09()
    if _tonumber("42")~=42 then return false end
    if _tonumber("ff",16)~=255 then return false end
    if _tonumber("0x10")~=16 then return false end
    if _tonumber("10")~=10 then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 10: TOSTRING
local function _L10()
    if _tostring(42)~="42" then return false end
    if _tostring(true)~="true" then return false end
    if _tostring("x")~="x" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 11: TYPE CHECK
local function _L11()
    if _type("x")~="string" then return false end
    if _type(1)~="number" then return false end
    if _type({})~="table" then return false end
    if _type(print)~="function" then return false end
    if _type(nil)~="nil" then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 12: PAIRS/IPAIRS
local function _L12()
    local t={a=1,b=2}
    local cnt=0
    for _ in _pairs(t) do cnt=cnt+1 end
    if cnt~=2 then return false end
    local t2={1,2,3}
    local cnt2=0
    for _ in _ipairs(t2) do cnt2=cnt2+1 end
    if cnt2~=3 then return false end
    return true
end

-- LAYER 18: OPAQUE 1
local function _OP1()

end

end

-- LAYER 25: OPAQUE 8
local function _OP8()

end

-- LAYER 26: HASH FNV
local function _H(s)
    local h=2166136261
    for i=1,#s do
        h=h~_s_byte(s,i)
        h=(h*16777619)&0xFFFFFFFF
    end
    return h
end

-- LAYER 27: HASH HEX
local function _HH(s)
    return _s_format("%08x", _H(s))
end

-- LAYER 28: ROTL8
local function _RL8(b,n) return ((b<<n)|(b>>(8-n)))&0xFF end

-- LAYER 29: ROTR8
local function _RR8(b,n) return ((b>>n)|(b<<(8-n)))&0xFF end

-- LAYER 30: DECODE BYTE (9-layer reverse)
local function _DB(b,pos,k)
    local keys=_CK
    -- Reverse 9 layers
    b=b~((keys[9]*(pos*27+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=_RR8(b,((pos+k+9)%7)+1)
    b=b~((keys[8]*(pos*24+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=b~((keys[7]*(pos*21+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=_RR8(b,((pos+k+7)%7)+1)
    b=b~((keys[6]*(pos*18+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=_RR8(b,((pos+k+6)%7)+1)
    b=b~((keys[5]*(pos*15+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=b~((keys[4]*(pos*12+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=_RR8(b,((pos+k+4)%7)+1)
    b=b~((keys[3]*(pos*9+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=_RR8(b,((pos+k+3)%7)+1)
    b=b~((keys[2]*(pos*6+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    b=b~((keys[1]*(pos*3+k)*2654435761)&0xFF)
    return b
end

-- LAYER 31: DECODE STRING
local function _DS(bytes,pos)
    local out={}
    for k=1,#bytes do
        out[k]=_s_char(_DB(bytes[k],pos,k))
    end
    return _t_concat(out)
end

-- LAYER 32: HEX TO BYTES
local function _H2B(h)
    local t={}
    for i=1,#h,2 do
        local b=_tonumber(_s_sub(h,i,i+1),16)
        if not b then return nil end
        t[#t+1]=b
    end
    return t
end

-- LAYER 33: ENGINE DETECTION
local function _ENG()
    local c={}
    if _type(load)=="function" then c[#c+1]=load end
    if _type(loadstring)=="function" then c[#c+1]=loadstring end
    for _,_f in _ipairs(c) do
        local o,t=_p_call(_f,"return 1+1")
        if o and _type(t)=="function" then
            local o2,v=_p_call(t)
            if o2 and v==2 then return _f end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- LAYER 34: OPCODE MAP PARSER
local function _PARSE_OM()
    local map={}
    local names={"PUSH","PUSH_CONST","JMP","JZ","JNZ","NOP","FUNC_ENTER","FUNC_EXIT",
        "LOOP_ENTER","LOOP_EXIT","BLOCK_END","FAKE_A","FAKE_B","FAKE_C","FAKE_D","FAKE_E",
        "TRAP_A","TRAP_B","HONEYPOT","DECOY_CALL"}
    for i=1,#names do
        local hx=_s_sub(_OM,(i-1)*2+1,i*2)
        map[names[i]]=_tonumber(hx,16)
    end
    return map
end

-- LAYER 35: CONST PARSER
local function _PARSE_CS()
    local consts={}
    local i=1
    while i<=#_CS do
        local len=_tonumber(_s_sub(_CS,i,i+3),16)
        if not len then return nil end
        i=i+4
        local dh=_s_sub(_CS,i,i+len*2-1)
        i=i+len*2
        local bytes=_H2B(dh)
        if not bytes then return nil end
        consts[#consts+1]=_DS(bytes,#consts+1)
    end
    return consts
end

-- LAYER 36: INST DECRYPT
local function _DI(opHex,aHex,bHex,cHex,pos)
    local op=_tonumber(opHex,16)
    local a=_tonumber(aHex,16)
    local b=_tonumber(bHex,16)
    local c=_tonumber(cHex,16)
    if not op or not a or not b or not c then return nil end
    local k=(_H("INSTKEY".._tostring(pos))*pos*2654435761)&0xFFFFFFFF
    local k1=(k>>24)&0xFF
    local k2=(k>>16)&0xFF
    local k3=(k>>8)&0xFF
    local k4=k&0xFF
    return op~k1, a~k2, b~k3, c~k4
end

-- LAYER 37: HANDLER FACTORY
local function _MAKE_HANDLERS(OM,CONSTS,CTX)
    local handlers={}
    local function add(name,fn) handlers[OM[name]]=fn end

    add("PUSH",function(a,b,c)
        local v=CONSTS[a+1]
        if v then CTX.acc[#CTX.acc+1]=v end
    end)

    add("PUSH_CONST",function(a,b,c)
        local v=CONSTS[a+1]
        if v then CTX.acc[#CTX.acc+1]=v end
    end)

    add("NOP",function(a,b,c)
        local v=CONSTS[a+1]
        if v then CTX.acc[#CTX.acc+1]=v end
    end)

    add("JZ",function(a,b,c)
        if CTX.flag==0 then CTX.pc=(a-1)*18+1 end
    end)

    add("JNZ",function(a,b,c)
        if CTX.flag~=0 then CTX.pc=(a-1)*18+1 end
    end)

    add("JMP",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.pc=(a-1)*18+1
    end)

    add("FUNC_ENTER",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.callstack[#CTX.callstack+1]={a=a}
    end)

    add("FUNC_EXIT",function(a,b,c)
        if #CTX.callstack>0 then _t_remove(CTX.callstack) end
    end)

    add("LOOP_ENTER",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.stack[#CTX.stack+1]=a
    end)

    add("LOOP_EXIT",function(a,b,c)
        if #CTX.stack>0 then
            local t=CTX.stack[#CTX.stack]
            _t_remove(CTX.stack)
            CTX.pc=(t-1)*18+1
        end
    end)

    add("BLOCK_END",function(a,b,c) end)

    add("FAKE_A",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.reg[CTX.cycle%32+1]=a
    end)

    add("FAKE_B",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.flag=CTX.flag~1
    end)

    add("FAKE_C",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.shadow[CTX.cycle%32+1]=a
    end)

    add("FAKE_D",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.stack[#CTX.stack+1]=c
        if #CTX.stack>50 then _t_remove(CTX.stack) end
    end)

    add("FAKE_E",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.reg[CTX.cycle%16+1]=b
    end)

    add("TRAP_A",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.trap_a=CTX.trap_a+1
        if CTX.trap_a>1000 then CTX.fail=true end
    end)

    add("TRAP_B",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.trap_b=CTX.trap_b+1
        if CTX.trap_b>1000 then CTX.fail=true end
    end)

    add("HONEYPOT",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.hp=CTX.hp+1
    end)

    add("DECOY_CALL",function(a,b,c)
        CTX.decoy=CTX.decoy+1
    end)

    return handlers
end

-- LAYER 38: VM DISPATCH
local function _VM()
    local OM=_PARSE_OM()
    local CONSTS=_PARSE_CS()
    if not CONSTS then return nil end

    local CTX={
        pc=1, acc={}, stack={}, reg={}, callstack={},
        flag=0, cycle=0, shadow={},
        trap_a=0, trap_b=0, hp=0, decoy=0, fail=false,
    }
    for i=1,32 do CTX.shadow[i]=i end

    local handlers=_MAKE_HANDLERS(OM,CONSTS,CTX)
    local N=#_BC

    while CTX.pc<=N do
        CTX.cycle=CTX.cycle+1
        if CTX.cycle>_NALL*100 then break end
        if CTX.fail then return nil end

        local p=(CTX.pc-1)*18+1
        local opHex=_s_sub(_BC,p,p+1)
        local aHex=_s_sub(_BC,p+2,p+5)
        local bHex=_s_sub(_BC,p+6,p+9)
        local cHex=_s_sub(_BC,p+10,p+13)

        local op,a,b,c=_DI(opHex,aHex,bHex,cHex,CTX.pc)
        if not op then return nil end

        local h=handlers[op]
        if h then
            h(a,b,c)
        else
            CTX.reg[CTX.cycle%32+1]=op
        end

        CTX.pc=CTX.pc+1
    end

    return _t_concat(CTX.acc),#CTX.acc
end
